narrNote: The District does NOT appear on NARR's official affiliate list and has no NARR state affiliate. DBH instead funds and oversees recovery residences directly (e.g., DBH Recovery Residence NOFA DCRR102822, posted on dbh.dc.gov).
notes: The District has no counties; DBH is simultaneously the state and local behavioral-health authority, so countyDirectory is not applicable. The Access HelpLine (1-888-7WE-HELP) is DBH's 24/7 entry point, featured on the verified DBH homepage; the agency phone is from the same page's footer. Medicaid SUD/IMD coverage runs through DHCF's Whole-Person Care Transformation 1115 demonstration — the verified DHCF 1115 page reports CMS approved a five-year renewal on Sept 23, 2026, effective Oct 1, 2026 through Sept 30, 2031. peerOrgs left empty per never-guess doctrine: DBH certifies peer specialists and runs the MyRecoveryDC peer campaign, but no standalone DC peer-run organization's site could be re-verified in-run before a browser fetch rate limit — flagged for a follow-up verification pass rather than guessed.
